# ANCBuddy 2.2.0
ANCBuddy 2.2.0 adds audio-source controls and makes live headphone status more reliable.
See which remembered device is streaming, switch to another source, or start pairing directly from ANCBuddy. If macOS is still using another output, ANCBuddy can reconnect the Bose audio route and guide you to Bluetooth Settings when needed.
The panel opens faster while device details finish loading in the background. It also recognizes Immersion with Still or Motion after live headphone adjustments, and keeps unconfirmed values neutral until fresh hardware status is available.
ANCBuddy now releases the Bose control connection cleanly when it quits and reuses an active status read when the panel is reopened instead of queueing duplicate connection attempts.
Use Contact Developer in the panel to start a support email containing only the ANCBuddy and macOS versions, never license information.
If you still have the old BoseControl app installed, quit and remove it after installing ANCBuddy to avoid two menu bar apps competing for the same headphones.
